coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across 9 primary products in scope (Mermaid, Graphviz, PlantUML, D2, Lucidchart, draw.io, Creately, Penrose, Visio) plus related tools (SmartDraw, EdrawMax, OmniGraffle). Coverage spans: (1) Official homepages and pricing pages (T0 primary capture); (2) Official documentation, changelogs, GitHub repositories (T1 official sources); (3) Review aggregates (Capterra, G2, TrustRadius) and funding databases (Crunchbase) (T2 analyst-grade); (4) Practitioner comparisons, technical articles, vendor blogs, and community discussions (T3 HCI/UX evidence). Deduplication applied across review sites. High-value sources prioritized: all review pages included for HCI pain signals; academic papers (Penrose ACM Transactions, SIGGRAPH) included where available; comparative analysis articles stress "drag-drop vs code-first" UX tradeoffs, which directly addresses MetroGraph's wedge against surface-area bloat and UI-vs-chat confusion. No Gartner/Forrester dedicated quadrant found for diagramming tools specifically (checked 2025-2026), but broader data governance/governance reports and Gartner Peer Insights entries captured.
